{{Quote|This is a... a map. Some sort of intergalactic navigational chart. Revan and Malak must have used this to lead them to the Star Forge.|[[Bastila Shan]]|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
The '''Search for the Star Maps''' was an operation executed by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his student [[Darth Malak|Malak]] in their search of the [[Star Map]]s, which could lead them to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Star Forge]].<ref name="KotOR" />

Revan and Malak visited the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|Rakatan ruins]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the [[Rakatan Ruins (Tatooine)|Rakatan ruins]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Builder Forge]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Hrakert Rift]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], and the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. They finally acquired the location of the Star Forge in the [[Lehon system]].<ref name="KotOR" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stationed at the [[Jedi Enclave]] on Dantooine were unaware that Revan and Malak traveled to the Rakatan ruins nearby, and the mission remained unknown to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] until an amnesiac Revan, being retrained in the ways of the Force, was sent to the Rakatan ruins as a Jedi trial.<ref name="KotOR" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', if the player chooses to find the Star Map on Kashyyyk after finding all the other Star Maps, they'll learn that Revan built the hologram interface for the [[Builder Forge]] [[3961 BBY|five years before]] the events of the game, which, combined with [[Dorak]] saying that the [[Mandalorian Wars]] ended [[3960 BBY|four years before]] the events of the game, implies that Revan found the Star Map on Kashyyyk one year before the Mandalorian Wars ended,<ref name="KotOR" /> but ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' says that Revan and Malak looked for the Star Forge after the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], who they met after the Mandalorian Wars ended, told them to.<ref name="Encyclopedi" />
